curtain_conflicts.text: a curtain strip has no switch or knob of its own (no new knobs): it follows the room's LOW knob, so it cannot stay dark while the cove is on, and it dims with it. In MBR and CBR that is the bedtime mood layer; in LIV it is the tray cove + TV bias + hall line.

K-LIV-LOW already uses its one amplifier (5 outputs = 3 knob + 2 amplifier); the curtain strip is output 6, so a second amplifier is needed (or a shared output, see output_sharing_options). P01 goes 92.2 -> 111.8 W, which the 10 % margin rule sizes at 240 W (was 200 W).

P07 (100 W, usable 60.0 W) cannot carry the DIN cove plus the curtain strip (69.3 W = 116 % of its usable): it needs 150 W, which supersedes the controls proposal's P07 resize to 100 W. K-DIN-LOW then has 2 of 3 outputs, no amplifier.

K-MBR-LOW has all 3 knob outputs used (3 -> 4); the 4th needs an amplifier, or the strip shares the C23 headboard output (1.13 A, fits the 2.4 A design limit) which is itself pending OI-MBR-04. P12 goes 90.8 -> 110.2 W, sized 240 W (was 200 W).

CBR strip is on P16 (108.6 -> 121.0 W, 84.0 % of usable, still 240 W). The shared P16 to SB-08 feed carries more current: C40 3.3 -> 3.6 % (MARGINAL, needs 2.5 mm2); the earlier remedy (2.5 mm2 feed, or keep P17 separate) now applies to the CBR strip as well. K-CBR-LOW goes to 3 of 3 outputs.
MBR W03 pocket is HELD (OI-MBR-04 / OI-MBR-02); if released, K-MBR-LOW needs 5 outputs (still 1 amplifier) and P12 reaches 122.3 W (84.9 % of the 240 W usable).

H-CURTAIN-POCKET: the pocket is ASSUMED 0.25 / 0.20 m and unmeasured; whether sheer + blackout tracks, brackets, the stack and a strip profile fit, the strip's setback behind the lip (hidden from standing and seated eye height), fabric clearance and heat of the sealed pocket are UNVERIFIED and need a site mock-up. The recorded clearance of the LIV-H2/H3 and DIN-H1 downlight cut-outs to the pocket (0.193 m at 0.25 m) tightens if the real pocket is wider than about 0.34 m.

no lux, luminance, uniformity or compliance credit is given to the curtain strips anywhere; every existing compliance status is unchanged. Curtains-closed (sheer / blackout) effect on the strip is not modelled.

the two photos show a stepped gypsum pocket (hall) and a recessed panel with a lip groove (children's room) but carry no scale and do not say which hall window (LIV or DIN) the hall photo shows; there is no photo for the MBR-side pocket. No dimension is read from them.

S1.meaning: each pocket strip becomes one more output of the room's existing LOW knob group and joins that room's existing cove supply (no new knob, no CCT control, no new supply)

S2.meaning: alternative: one small dedicated 24 V supply per pocket beside the knob board; no existing supply is resized, but 4 more supplies/isolators/hatch spaces

S3.meaning: S1 plus the held MBR W03 pocket (only if OI-MBR-04 / OI-MBR-02 release it); shown so the supply sizing is not a surprise later

holds_new.text: Knob, amplifiers and supplies share the 0 V (common negative) exactly as the knob/amplifier maker shows; K-LIV-LOW spans two supplies (P01 + P03), so its P03 outputs need a matched PWM amplifier fed from P03 with a common 0 V. Confirm on the sample bench (3 amplifiers with the curtain strips); fallback if the bench fails: split the living LOW layer onto a second knob (one more control).
Children's room C39/C40 voltage drop is MARGINAL (3.3 % and 3.6 % with the curtain strip): a 2.5 mm2 shared feed from P16 to SB-08, or a separate supply, is needed; the electrician decides.
Grooming levels: bath HIGH, mirror pair and face pair levels are set on site with the homeowner; no lux credit is claimed for knob positions.

2700 K strip RFQ: 24 V constant-voltage single-channel COB strip with maker-stated PWM dimming, CRI >= 90, R9 >= 50, lumens per metre at 2700 K, aluminium profile + opal diffuser, IP variant per location; no product is approved.
Passage C10: its supply is switched upstream 2-way (SB-02 / SB-07); the T1-K power-on state (memory of last level vs. default) must be confirmed so the passage light returns at a usable level.
24 V spots (balcony, baths, dressing, lobby, study) must be maker-stated constant-voltage PWM-dimmable 24 V fittings; constant-current modules are not put on a CV knob.

Curtain-pocket strips: pocket width/depth/run unmeasured; two tracks (sheer + blackout) plus brackets, stack and profile must fit; strip set back behind the lip; fabric must not touch the strip or profile; no driver inside the pocket; CBR window is a placeholder; MBR W03 pocket held; site mock-up before any order.
